title: Two Sum [Set 1]
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. (Assessment Problem 1)
inputFormat: First line: integer n. Second line: n space-separated integers. Third line: integer target.
hints: Consider using a HashMap for O(1) average lookup.
Check edge cases with empty input or single elements.
editorial: Optimal solution uses O(n) time and O(n) space.

title: Valid Anagram [Set 2]
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. (Assessment Problem 2)
inputFormat: Two lines containing string s and string t.

examples.explanation: Both strings contain identical character frequencies.

hints: Consider using a HashMap for O(1) average lookup.
Check edge cases with empty input or single elements.
editorial: Optimal solution uses O(n) time and O(1) space.

title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's) [Set 3]

outputFormat: Single integer representing the maximum subarray sum.
